title: The cheapest booking you'll ever get is the second one.
styleLine: ONE CONSISTENT LINE ACROSS ALL IMAGES (critical). Cinematic editorial photography, shot as if by the SAME photographer on the SAME 35mm lens, same warm natural grade — deep navy shadows (#262B38) + warm cream light (#F7F8EA), rich but natural (NOT a heavy Instagram filter, NOT washed-out, NOT HDR). Modern boutique-hotel world: walnut wood, cream plaster, greenery, contemporary fixtures. NO dated props (no key racks, service bells, fountain pens, paper ledgers, cash). Elegant, quiet, expensive. 4:5 (1080x1350). No text, no logos, no clearly identifiable faces.
note: Path B. Slide 4 is a DEVICE-COMPOSITE (phone, blank white screen). All other slides are pure photos.

slides.imagePrompt: A guest sitting by a bright window in a boutique hotel room with a coffee, seen from the side, face soft and not the focus. Warm cream light, linen, a plant, walnut side table. The subject or device must sit in the UPPER ~55-60% of the frame, leaving a clean, uncluttered, darker LOWER ~40% for text. [Apply the STYLE LINE.]
slides.headline:
The cheapest booking you'll ever get
is the ==second one==.
slides.sub: If you're allowed to ask for it.

slides.imagePrompt: A boutique-hotel reception counter at checkout time: walnut surface, a small plant, a card terminal turned away from camera, warm daylight. No people, no readable text. The subject or device must sit in the UPPER ~55-60% of the frame, leaving a clean, uncluttered, darker LOWER ~40% for text. [Apply the STYLE LINE.]
slides.title: They leave, and that's usually the end
slides.body: No address you own, no permission to write, no reason for them to think of you in eleven months.

slides.imagePrompt: A close, tactile shot of folded white linen and a small sprig of greenery on a walnut surface in warm side light. Quiet, expensive, editorial. The subject or device must sit in the UPPER ~55-60% of the frame, leaving a clean, uncluttered, darker LOWER ~40% for text. [Apply the STYLE LINE.]
slides.title: A direct guest gave you ==an inbox==
slides.body: Which means a thank-you, a photo of the room they liked, and an offer for the same week next year.

slides.imagePrompt: DEVICE-COMPOSITE SLIDE — read carefully. The phone must be PERFECTLY STRAIGHT AND FRONT-ON: screen plane exactly parallel to the camera, ZERO rotation, ZERO tilt, no perspective, edges square to the frame. Its screen must be a COMPLETELY BLANK PURE-WHITE rectangle (#FFFFFF) — no UI, no icons, no text, no reflections, no glare, nothing overlapping it, all four corners fully visible with a little clearance. The device sits in the UPPER ~55% of the frame; the LOWER ~40% is a clean, empty, softly-shadowed darker surface for text. Deliver ONE SINGLE CONTINUOUS PHOTOGRAPH natively in 4:5 (1080x1350). Do NOT letterbox, pad, extend or outpaint — no horizontal seam anywhere; the empty lower area must be part of the photographed scene (a real table top, floor or wall in shadow).
slides.title: One email. No commission.
slides.body: The second stay costs you a sentence and a send button.

slides.imagePrompt: Two coffee cups on a walnut table by a window in a warm boutique hotel, morning light, plant nearby, nobody present. Suggests a returning couple. The subject or device must sit in the UPPER ~55-60% of the frame, leaving a clean, uncluttered, darker LOWER ~40% for text. [Apply the STYLE LINE.]
slides.title: Loyalty isn't a programme
slides.body: It's remembering them, and being able to reach them. The second is the part the middleman takes.

slides.imagePrompt: A boutique-hotel room door slightly ajar with warm light spilling into a calm corridor, walnut and cream, a plant on a console. No text or numbers on the door. The subject or device must sit in the UPPER ~55-60% of the frame, leaving a clean, uncluttered, darker LOWER ~40% for text. [Apply the STYLE LINE.]
slides.headline:
Get the first stay direct.
==Own every one after.==
